name: Manu Alzuru
description: Manu Alzuru is a Venezuelan artist-founder, engineer, DJ, music producer and community architect working across Ethereum, music, public goods, DAOs and cultural infrastructure. He founded and produced ETHBarcelona, helped coordinate Ethereum Devcon since 2019, founded Blockravers, contributed to projects including DoinGud, API3, MetaCartel, FightPandemics, and now leads Lovepunks, a society-building project exploring music, care, ritual spaces, residencies, commons, identity and trust networks.
